title: Add edit-history diff viewer for memory records
description:
## Human Auditing Recommendation 2

### Problem
When a human auditor reviews a memory record, there is no way to see what changed, when, or by whom. The only metadata is `LastUpdated` — no audit trail, no diff, no rollback.

### Suggested Implementation
1. Capture a lightweight change record on every `UpdateAsync` call in `MemoryApplicationService` — store as a JSON-diff entry (before/after key fields: Tags, Content, Status, Confidence, References, Conflicts, SourceLinks)
2. Expose via a `GET /api/memories/{id}/history` endpoint
3. Add a "History" tab in the read-only memory detail view showing chronological diffs with green/red highlighting for added/removed lines

### Why It Helps Human Auditing
An auditor needs to verify that changes to Core memories are legitimate and traceable. Without history, any unexpected edit is invisible.

### Confidence: 75%
